trailhead.name: Donner Summit / Boreal Ridge PCT trailhead (Castle Peak Road exit 176, I-80)

identifiedBy.fact: hike starts at exit 176 I-80; PCT trailhead south side; parking north side lot or sno-park; route reaches Castle Pass then northeast along ridge to NW turret

placements.name: DONERS Donner Pass south parking area

otherFacts.value: northwest turret is a walk-up; true summit is the east turret, class 3/4 summit block
sno-park Nov 1 to May 30, pass required
PCT north to Castle Pass adds 1-2 mi each way

notes: Moderate: donnersummitca page confirms Castle Pass route and exit 176 start, but names no trailhead and gives no coordinate (sno-park Google link ~39.3397,-120.3432, consistent). The climber.org GPX placement is from an earlier pass, not re-read. Summer alternative: high-clearance driving up Castle Valley to parking at base of Castle Pass (not placed). The route reaches the NW turret, which that page says is not the true summit.

Sibling scramble starts at Ross Dam TH (another side). No coordinate printed; empty placements, name for OSM match. Trailhead is in Canada. Hold for review.
